summary: In-process .NET workers that shut down cleanly: a bounded Channel<T> with an explicit FullMode, scoped services resolved per item inside ExecuteAsync, per-item try/catch rethrowing OperationCanceledException only on the stopping token, PeriodicTimer instead of a Task.Delay loop, and ILogger scopes per item.

assumes_loaded.why: Hosted service runs inside the same Generic Host as the API
